judge: the assistant, in one context, after reading all twelve blinded notes
criterion: craft and ambition as evidenced by the notes: grasp of the defect, principle vs patch, what was built beyond the minimum, honesty about what was not done
caveat: Position bias cannot be measured cleanly here. The judge read all twelve entries before any pair was shown, so a stable prior was already formed and the swap rate below is a LOWER BOUND on what an independent judge would show.
design: 12 entries in a ring plus 10 chords = 22 pairs, each presented in both orders = 44 judgments. F|L added after a connectivity failure; see addendum.

notes.G: gate economy: noticed that without it the inner equator is trivially fastest and the topology is wasted, then designed the −0.25s/+1.2s economy to make the spiral optimal. Sharpest game-design argument in the set.
notes.C: harmonic field with a gameplay consequence the author noticed and used — jumps become harmonic-oscillator arcs, turning 'jump the tube' into a line-choice move. Best physics-to-play link.
notes.E: best diagnosis of the defect: 422 of 1728 interior samples failing, concentrated exactly where you land.
notes.A: metric correction so physical speed is constant; identified the missing 5 of its own 95/100.
notes.K: (2,1) knot where everyone else took (1,1) — the boldest track choice.
notes.I: (u+v)/2 progress metric provably requires both loops.
notes.H: shell-theorem argument that uniform apparent gravity is the definition, not an approximation.
notes.J: wall-clock rather than accumulated dt, 'so lag can't lie about your time'.
notes.L: competent but the least distinctive: mostly a feature list.
notes.F: more seam-contract listing than design reasoning.

addendum: F never won a comparison in the original 21-pair design, which makes its Bradley-Terry strength unbounded below and the MLE non-existent. The cause is a gap in the design, not in the verdicts: F and L were never compared, and they are the two weakest entries. F|L was added in both orders after the failure, before any fit was produced. The judgment is genuinely close and split by order, which is recorded rather than resolved.
